evidence_summary: Run 39838415410 measures the shipped product counter-signal layer on a frozen 24-envelope OpenCaseLaw cache (4 questions, 14 reached known-counter authorities). All 7 controls pass (pins, cache/pool parity, module identity, planted/blank-topic, zero network, deterministic repeat, head match). 5/7 gates pass: G1 (offline signals on all 4 questions), G3 (3/5 hydrated known rows signal), G4 (hydration surface non-vacuous at 35.7%), G6 (all 16 signals carry verbatim evidence), G7 (pool provenance and duplicate-free). Two gates fail as designed falsifiers: G2 (0/14 reached known signalled offline) and G5 (0 vs 1 on marker rule's own title+regeste+snippet surface). Hydration sensitivity shows the heuristic works when full text exists (3/5), but only 5/14 reached rows have it. Pre-freeze scratch reconnaissance disclosed; no network; deterministic; claim ceiling explicit and narrow. No leakage, weak baselines, benchmark gaming, prettiness-as-quality, boilerplate confounding, or unsupported claims detected. Valid negative measurement; product lane owns repair.
